per_view.notes: Overlong grey tube with blunt nose and abrupt tail. Front hump with upper window row is present and correctly placed. Wing is only a thin flat plate edge-on; one boxy engine block under belly, not four nacelles. Tail is two wire-thin lines, no solid fin/tailplane. Tiny floating wheels; uniform flat grey.

Top-down: slender tube ~10x diameter with rounded nose but blunt untapered tail. Wing is a single rectangular unswept, untapered slab; four small nacelle stubs sit atop it, no pylons or forward offset. Front-third oval hump and cockpit mark present. Dashed window rows both sides. Thin fin edge and swept stab lines at tail. Coherent grey scheme.

critic.fix_suggestion: Improve 'Wing sweep (~37.5 deg), dihedral, taper' (mean 3/10). Target the 8 anchor: clearly swept-back (~35-40 deg) tapering wings with visible upward dihedral, mounted at the lower mid-fuselage; then the 10 anchor: realistic planform: strong sweep, root-to-tip chord and thickness taper, dihedral, plausible span (~0.9x body length), wing roots faired into the belly.
